summary: Frontend regression test of RMMG/IRS bug fix in Contabilista IA (/contabilista). All 7 scenarios PASSED. Art.º 70 CIRS logic correctly applied: workers at Portuguese minimum wage (RMMG 920€/2026) are now exempt from IRS. Badges + warnings render correctly. Chat IA integration also confirms new legal logic.

critical_code_review_comments: ptTax.js RMMG_2026=920 and MINIMO_EXISTENCIA=920*14=12880 — matches Decreto-Lei 139/2025.
calcIRSAnual correctly returns 0 when rendimentoAnual <= MINIMO_EXISTENCIA (Art.º 70 CIRS full exemption), plus safeguard that líquido never falls below the minimum existence — mathematically sound.

ContabilistaPage.jsx SimuladorContratacao uses `sim.irsAnual === 0 && Number(bruto) > 0` for isentoIRS — this could also fire when calcIRSAnual returns 0 for very low income WITHOUT law reason. Since the exemption applies for ALL incomes ≤ MINIMO_EXISTENCIA that is legally correct here, but the badge text is only strictly true when Art.º 70 applies. Consider using explicit check `sim.salarioAnualBase + sim.subsidios + sim.premios <= MINIMO_EXISTENCIA` to future-proof. Non-blocking.

Tab 2 (LiquidoBruto) does NOT display any 'ISENTO/Art.º 70' badge when brutoAnual ≤ MINIMO_EXISTENCIA — for consistency with Tab 1, a similar badge would improve UX (users may not understand why IRS shows 0€). Non-blocking, but recommended for parity.
Warning threshold uses strict less-than (`Number(bruto) < RMMG_2026`) — 920 is not flagged (correct: 920 IS the RMMG). 919.99 would be flagged. OK.

hire-bruto Input type=number allows arbitrary values without max/step attributes — user can enter 0 or negative. Minor UX; validation on submit not needed since it's a simulator, but consider min='0'.

rca of the issue: Original bug: prior MINIMO_EXISTENCIA = 12 180€ (based on 2025 RMMG 870€), and calcIRSAnual immediately applied progressive brackets on all incomes. When bruto=920 → brutoAnual = 12 880€, that exceeded the outdated threshold and produced ~1500€ IRS — violating Art.º 70 CIRS. Fix: bumped RMMG_2026 to 920€ (DL 139/2025), MINIMO_EXISTENCIA to 920×14=12 880€, added early-return exemption + líquido-floor safeguard. Verified in UI: bruto=920 now yields IRS=0 and líquido ≈ 951€.
